newsitem.title: CHINA: Foreign investment in China up 4.0 pct in Jan-July.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment in China up 4.0 pct in Jan-July.

text.p: Foreign investment in China increased in the first seven months of this year, with actual investment reaching $26.81 billion, up by 4.0 percent, with direct investment up by 13.2 percent, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
Pledged new foreign investment agreements amounted to $53.52 billion, a year-on-year increase of 35.2 percent, while direct investment grew by 31.7 percent, it said.

In January-July, ventures solely funded by foreign investors increased, with new agreements signed worth $18.44 billion, a jump of 55.1 percent, and actual investment growing by 24.3 percent, it said.
Investment accelerated in China's more backward central and western regions, with actual foreign investment rising 38.3 percent in central China and 55.6 percent in remote western China, it said.
